name: shiftease-movers
description: ShiftEase Movers - MERN packers & movers platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
